shortDescription: Run command in a new container of a Compose service

options.name: api_version
options.description: The version of the Docker API running on the Docker Host. Defaults to the latest version of the API supported by this collection and the docker daemon. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(DOCKER_API_VERSION) will be used instead. If the environment variable is not set, the default value will be used.

options.name: argv
options.description: The command to execute. Since this is a list of arguments, no quoting is needed. O(argv) or O(command) are mutually exclusive.

options.name: build
options.description: Build image before starting container. Note that building can insert information into RV(stdout) or RV(stderr).

options.name: ca_path
options.description: Use a CA certificate when performing server verification by providing the path to a CA certificate file. If the value is not specified in the task and the environment variable E(DOCKER_CERT_PATH) is set, the file C(ca.pem) from the directory specified in the environment variable E(DOCKER_CERT_PATH) will be used.

options.name: cap_add
options.description: Linux capabilities to add to the container.

options.name: cap_drop
options.description: Linux capabilities to drop from the container.

options.name: chdir
options.description: The directory to run the command in.

options.name: check_files_existing
options.description: If set to V(false), the module will not check whether one of the files C(compose.yaml), C(compose.yml), C(docker-compose.yaml), or C(docker-compose.yml) exists in O(project_src) if O(files) is not provided. This can be useful if environment files with C(COMPOSE_FILE) are used to configure a different filename. The module currently does not check for C(COMPOSE_FILE) in environment files or the current environment.

options.name: cleanup
options.description: Automatically remove th econtainer when it exits. Corresponds to the C(--rm) option of C(docker compose run).

options.name: cli_context
options.description: The Docker CLI context to use. Mutually exclusive with O(docker_host).

options.name: client_cert
options.description: Path to the client's TLS certificate file. If the value is not specified in the task and the environment variable E(DOCKER_CERT_PATH) is set, the file C(cert.pem) from the directory specified in the environment variable E(DOCKER_CERT_PATH) will be used.

options.name: client_key
options.description: Path to the client's TLS key file. If the value is not specified in the task and the environment variable E(DOCKER_CERT_PATH) is set, the file C(key.pem) from the directory specified in the environment variable E(DOCKER_CERT_PATH) will be used.

options.name: command
options.description: The command to execute. O(argv) or O(command) are mutually exclusive.

options.name: definition
options.description: Compose file describing one or more services, networks and volumes. Mutually exclusive with O(project_src) and O(files). One of O(project_src) and O(definition) must be provided. If provided, PyYAML must be available to this module, and O(project_name) must be specified. Note that a temporary directory will be created and deleted afterwards when using this option.

options.name: detach
options.description: Whether to run the command synchronously (O(detach=false), default) or asynchronously (O(detach=true)). If set to V(true), O(stdin) cannot be provided, and the return values RV(stdout), RV(stderr), and RV(rc) are not returned. Instead, the return value RV(container_id) is provided.

options.name: docker_cli
options.description: Path to the Docker CLI. If not provided, will search for Docker CLI on the E(PATH).

options.name: docker_host
options.description: The URL or Unix socket path used to connect to the Docker API. To connect to a remote host, provide the TCP connection string. For example, V(tcp://192.0.2.23:2376). If TLS is used to encrypt the connection, the module will automatically replace C(tcp) in the connection URL with C(https). If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(DOCKER_HOST) will be used instead. If the environment variable is not set, the default value will be used. Mutually exclusive with

options.name: entrypoint
options.description: Override the entrypoint of the container image.

options.name: env
options.description: Dictionary of environment variables with their respective values to be passed to the command ran inside the container. Values which might be parsed as numbers, booleans or other types by the YAML parser must be quoted (for example V("true")) in order to avoid data loss. Please note that if you are passing values in with Jinja2 templates, like V("{{ value }}"), you need to add V(| string) to prevent Ansible to convert strings such as V("true") back to booleans. The correct way is to use V("{{ val

options.name: env_files
options.description: By default environment files are loaded from a C(.env) file located directly under the O(project_src) directory. O(env_files) can be used to specify the path of one or multiple custom environment files instead. The path is relative to the O(project_src) directory.

options.name: files
options.description: List of Compose file names relative to O(project_src) to be used instead of the main Compose file (C(compose.yml), C(compose.yaml), C(docker-compose.yml), or C(docker-compose.yaml)). Files are loaded and merged in the order given. Mutually exclusive with O(definition).

options.name: interactive
options.description: Whether to keep STDIN open even if not attached.

options.name: labels
options.description: Add or override labels to the container.

options.name: name
options.description: Assign a name to the container.

options.name: no_deps
options.description: Do not start linked services.

options.name: profiles
options.description: List of profiles to enable when starting services. Equivalent to C(docker compose --profile).

options.name: project_name
options.description: Provide a project name. If not provided, the project name is taken from the basename of O(project_src). Required when O(definition) is provided.

options.name: project_src
options.description: Path to a directory containing a Compose file (C(compose.yml), C(compose.yaml), C(docker-compose.yml), or C(docker-compose.yaml)). If O(files) is provided, will look for these files in this directory instead. Mutually exclusive with O(definition). One of O(project_src) and O(definition) must be provided.

options.name: publish
options.description: Publish a container's port(s) to the host.

options.name: quiet_pull
options.description: Pull without printing progress information. Note that pulling can insert information into RV(stdout) or RV(stderr).

options.name: remove_orphans
options.description: Remove containers for services not defined in the Compose file.

options.name: service
options.description: The service to run the command in.

options.name: service_ports
options.description: Run command with all service's ports enabled and mapped to the host.

options.name: stdin
options.description: Set the stdin of the command directly to the specified value. Can only be used if O(detach=false).

options.name: stdin_add_newline
options.description: If set to V(true), appends a newline to O(stdin).

options.name: strip_empty_ends
options.description: Strip empty lines from the end of stdout/stderr in result.

options.name: tls
options.description: Secure the connection to the API by using TLS without verifying the authenticity of the Docker host server. Note that if O(validate_certs) is set to V(true) as well, it will take precedence. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(DOCKER_TLS) will be used instead. If the environment variable is not set, the default value will be used.

options.name: tls_hostname
options.description: When verifying the authenticity of the Docker Host server, provide the expected name of the server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(DOCKER_TLS_HOSTNAME) will be used instead. If the environment variable is not set, the default value will be used.

options.name: tty
options.description: Whether to allocate a TTY.

options.name: use_aliases
options.description: Use the service's network C(useAliases) in the network(s) the container connects to.

options.name: user
options.description: If specified, the user to execute this command with.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Secure the connection to the API by using TLS and verifying the authenticity of the Docker host server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(DOCKER_TLS_VERIFY) will be used instead. If the environment variable is not set, the default value will be used.

options.name: volumes
options.description: Bind mount one or more volumes.
